This is my go-to for keto and this makes enough for a few meals for 1 person.

You need:

  • 1.5 lbs of chopped pork (preferably some of that being bacon)
  • greens (I usually use an entire bag of either frozen collard greens or diced turnips/turnip greens)
  • curry powder
  • salt
  • 1 pkg of cream cheese
  • ghost pepper sauce/powder (optional)

Directions:

I usually fry up the pork in a cast iron pan, and if it's fatty enough, I don't have to put in any extra oil or anything in it. Once the fat starts rendering out a bit and it's frying, I put in 1-2 tbsp of curry powder in, and 1 tsp of salt. And then I mix it all up.

When the pork is done, I put the bag of frozen greens in and mix it up. Once it's all thawed and cooked a little and mixed up good, I'll put in the ghost pepper sauce (1 tbsp [this will make it pretty hot]) and mix it all up. Once it's mixed in, then I put in the pkg of cream cheese and mix it all in good. Once it's all incorporated, it's done.

If you have similar recipes or you make this and have improved on it, let me know because I want to try it.
